_Migrated from issue #839, filed 2026-07-11._

Magic-shelf Kobo delivery needs its per-book sub-cursor tracked independently so large shelves terminate and drain without repeats or drops.

Credit: @recruiterguy and #359.

Promise (2026-06-05): “The follow-up improvement to fully paginate within the magic-shelf arm is tracked separately.”

Source: https://github.com/new-usemame/Calibre-Web-NextGen/issues/359
title: Magic-shelf pagination: full cursor (magic_shelf_last_id residual)
